syntheticDisclosure.statement: All 13 regions, 12 portals, 3 frames, route geometry, portal closure state, entity observations, and team reports in this record are synthetic design data. They are not surveyed Korail facility geometry and are not operational procedure acceptance.
limits: All entity placements, roles, teams, frames, and portal closures are synthetic design inputs.
Negative observation tests assert confidentiality of synthetic incident data before discovery, not physical security verification.
The four surfaces (Authoritative Server, Projected Client View, Route/Guidance Projection, and UI Display) operate under pure algorithmic contracts.

runRecord.commitNote: Runs executed against the isolated feature branch with candidate test implementation and verified against local Unity CLI Editor test runner.

issueTestCases.name: EquipmentConsistencyMatchesAuthoritativeResponseAcrossAllSurfaces
issueTestCases.surfaceScope: Equipment: Server state -> Client ObservedState.Entities -> Operate command acceptance -> Stale revision rejection

issueTestCases.name: PortalConsistencyMatchesAuthoritativeResponseAcrossAllSurfaces
issueTestCases.surfaceScope: Portal: Active door -> Portal Open -> Route available vs Inactive door -> Portal Closed -> Route blocked unavailable

issueTestCases.name: FrameConsistencyMatchesAuthoritativeResponseAcrossAllSurfaces
issueTestCases.surfaceScope: Frame: Local-to-world Point3 translation -> Moving frame displacement -> Route CrossesFrame boundary projection

issueTestCases.name: ReportConsistencyMatchesAuthoritativeResponseAcrossAllSurfaces
issueTestCases.surfaceScope: Report: Submit report -> Teammate observed report reception -> Cross-team isolation -> Teammate acknowledge

issueTestCases.name: ObservedIdsExcludedInformationIsAbsentFromViewRouteAndUiNegativeScenario
issueTestCases.surfaceScope: Negative Suppression: Undiscovered incident excluded from ObservedState -> Excluded from Route/Guidance -> Report rejected (NotObserved)

issueTestCases.name: StaleFrameOrReportMismatchCreatesExplicitFailedResultNotSilentSelection
issueTestCases.surfaceScope: Explicit Failures: Stale revision (StaleTarget) -> Missing report (UnknownTarget) -> Out of reach (OutOfReach)

issueTestCases.name: SnapshotFreshnessScopeAndFourSurfaceScopeAreSeparatelyReported
issueTestCases.surfaceScope: Scope Separation: SnapshotFreshness network transport timing vs Four-Surface semantic observation consistency

acceptanceAssertions.criterion: each of equipment, portal, frame, report has an executed consistency scenario against its named authoritative response.
ObservedIds-excluded information is absent from UI/view/route negative scenario.
acceptanceAssertions.evidence: ObservedIdsExcludedInformationIsAbsentFromViewRouteAndUiNegativeScenario: Verified absence in ObservedState.Entities, RouteDisplayState hints, TrainingGuidanceState, and explicit rejection on unobserved report submission (CommandCode.NotObserved)

acceptanceAssertions.criterion: stale frame or report mismatch creates explicit failed/rejected result, not client-side silent selection.
acceptanceAssertions.evidence: StaleFrameOrReportMismatchCreatesExplicitFailedResultNotSilentSelection: Explicit CommandCode.StaleTarget, CommandCode.UnknownTarget, and CommandCode.OutOfReach returned without client-side silent drop or fallback

acceptanceAssertions.criterion: existing SnapshotFreshness test scope and new four-surface test scope are separately reported.
acceptanceAssertions.evidence: SnapshotFreshnessScopeAndFourSurfaceScopeAreSeparatelyReported: Validates strict metric and architectural separation between network timing freshness (SnapshotFreshness) and four-surface spatial/permission consistency
